behavior: For generated opted-in log fixtures whose namespace, pod, container, workload, observedAt, source, message, and optional test.run_id values are mutually distinct, submitting each collector-emitted request through IngestService preserves every named value in the captured normalized record.
rationale: A source-fixture to collector-wire to normalized-record round trip proves all required diagnostic fields survive the boundary and exposes swapped, dropped, or overwritten metadata.
